answer: Require agents to post a refundable bond before they can attest answers, with slashing when their grade diverges from the panel consensus. An attacker spinning up thousands of sybils then faces a cost ridge: each fake identity must lock real capital, and every dishonest vote forfeits part of its stake. Like a gale scattering unmoored tents, consensus slashing sweeps away cheap identities while honest agents stand firm. Once a sybil's bond is seized, its account drops off the ledge of eligibility and can never rejoin, so fake identities stay unprofitable by design.
